stories.title: Long-lived ytterbium states could sharpen quantum computing and atomic clocks
stories.desc: Researchers from the University of Amsterdam and the University of New South Wales have answered a question that has been around for decades: whether ions of the metal ytterbium can enter certain long-lived, nearly stable states and, if so, for how long.
